text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our second summer camp has come to a
close. Before we return to the academy,
I find Fine
Motion staring intently at the
grounds.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's quite all right!
I just thought I'd like
to etch
this sight into my mind.
choice_data_list: If there's anything left you wante...
If there's anything left you wante...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I never want to forget everything that
happened here and the things I
learned... and the salty
flavor of the
beach house's ramen...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: ...Want to grab a bite at the end?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My final bowl of camp ramen! Let's go at
once!
